channel.title: Not Always Right - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Not Always Right (notalwaysright.com)

item.title: The Hundred Dollar Stare
item.description: Customer: *Hands me a $100 bill.* Me: "Oh, I'm sorry, I only have $5 bills in my drawer. Do you have something smaller?" Customer: *Just blankly looks at me and doesn’t say anything.*

item.title: Not The Kind Of Ride Where You Can Take A Backseat
item.description: Me: "Hi there, sir. Just a quick heads-up that some guests find this ride a bit uncomfortable, depending on body shape and the restraint design. I just want to make sure you have the best experience." Customer: "Are you calling me fat?"

item.title: Ignorance Is A Grill Thing
item.description: Customer's Son: "What's that yellow stuff?" Me: "Excuse me, sir, what yellow stuff?" Customer's Son: "That yellow stuff you're putting all over the burger."

item.title: The Benjamin Button Bar Crawl
item.description: As we pull up, it hits me that I don't have my license with me. I wasn't the driver, so I didn't think to grab it. We're a ways away from the house, so I feel bad having ruined the trip, as we will have to go back, get my ID, then come back to the store again.

item.title: Change Of Mind
item.description: Customer: "Counting difficult for you, eh?" Me: "Hehe, math was never my strongest subject." Customer: "That's why you ended up in a dead-end retail job instead of going to college."
